segments.text: I (whiche am a priſoner of the Lordes) exhorte you, that ye walke worthy of the vocacion wherwyth ye are called, with all lowlines and mekenes, with humblenes of mind, forbearyng one another through loue, and be delygente to kepe the vnytie of the ſpirite through the bonde of peace, being one body and one ſpirite, euen as ye are called in one hope of your callyng. Let there be but one Lorde, one faith, one baptiſme, one God and father of all, which is aboue all, and through all, and in you all.
